|strategy=By [mailto:jediknight@decipher.com Justin Pakes, Jedi Knight]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/endor/light/small/chewbaccasbowcaster.html</ref>

So you've always wished that [[Chewbacca]] had a lightsaber? Well, that was never really going to happen,. so here's the next best thing. A personalized bowcaster!

For firing purposes, this is as effective as a lightsaber. Free deploy and free firing, two destiny draws, forfeit = 0. It lacks the drain text of lightsabers, but you cannot have everything. in fact, if you stock it in a [[Wookiee]] deck, you may actually be able to deploy it on a non-unique "walking carpet". Not cheap, but possible!

Owning a weapon pretty much makes you the #1 target for your opponent's weapons. So use [[Chewbacca Of Kashyyyk]] if you can for his extended defense value, or give [[Chewie (The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game){{!}}Chewie]] a cape. And look out for the Dark Lord of [[Choke]]!

Combo:

= your opponent has two characters less than he started the turn with, and it's only the [[Control (Coruscant){{!}}Control]] Phase!
